title: Daily Devotional #45
paragraphs: Today, I read Luke 1 and was struck by the story of Zechariah and Elizabeth. As I read about their faith and trust in you, I couldn't help but feel inspired and encouraged.

Zechariah and Elizabeth were both righteous in your sight, and they followed your commandments faithfully. However, they were unable to have children, which was seen as a great disgrace in their culture. Despite this, they continued to trust in you and serve you faithfully.

Then, one day, everything changed. An angel appeared to Zechariah and told him that Elizabeth would bear a son who would be filled with the Holy Spirit from birth and would prepare the way for the Lord. Zechariah was skeptical and questioned the angel, but eventually, he came to believe and was struck mute until the day his son, John, was born.

As I read this story, I was reminded that your plans for our lives are greater than we could ever imagine. Even when we face difficult circumstances or seemingly impossible situations, we can trust in your goodness and faithfulness. Just like Zechariah and Elizabeth, we can continue to serve you and follow your commandments, even when it feels like our prayers are not being answered.

Lord, I pray that you would help me to trust in you more fully, even when I don't understand what you're doing in my life. Help me to remember that your plans are perfect and that you are always working for my good. Thank you for the example of Zechariah and Elizabeth, and for their faithfulness and trust in you.
